sections.overview:
Spellbook (formerly Claude Arsenal) is a comprehensive skill library with 83 battle-tested skills and 7 specialized agents designed for Claude Code, Codex, and multi-agent workflows. It provides modular, production-ready skills across development architecture, product lifecycle, code quality, DevOps, and UI design—organized by workflow so you can install exactly what you need. The library uses a validated registry and progressive disclosure patterns for larger skills, making it practical for engineering teams, product managers, and operations specialists. Install selectively by workflow or grab all 83 skills at once with a single command.
Frontend and UI development with design system and Figma-to-React workflows
Code quality audits, bug fixes, and systematic debugging
Server deployment, security hardening, and infrastructure diagnosis
Product discovery, PRD creation, and technical specification writing
I need to migrate a PostgreSQL database to MongoDB for my e-commerce platform. The database contains customer data, product listings, and transaction records.
